FR-012 states the system must calculate the absolute p‑value shift for masking proportions **[deferred]–[deferred]**, but the concrete proportion range is missing, rendering the functional requirement unverifiable.
The scenario mentions a “minimum of **[deferred] iterations**” for the Moving Block Bootstrap, leaving the required number of bootstrap samples undefined and thus not testable.
The sensitivity analysis scenario specifies a proportion of data “**[deferred]–[deferred]**” to be randomly masked without concrete bounds, preventing reproducible testing.
The masking proportion for the sensitivity analysis is given as “**[deferred]–[deferred]**”, lacking concrete values needed to execute the test.
